body_markdown:
**WESTERLY, R.I.** – The Washington Trust Company ([Washington Trust](https://www.washtrust.com/) ) today announced that Angela DiPasquale and Brian Kenney have joined the Bank as vice presidents in its commercial real estate banking group.


DiPasquale focuses on commercial real estate across Rhode Island and Connecticut. Kenney is based in the Bank’s Wellesley, Mass., office alongside the Bank’s institutional banking group and its wealth management team, and serves as the company’s first Greater Boston-based commercial real estate officer.


DiPasquale and Kenney both most recently served on commercial real estate teams at Beacon Bank & Trust.


*DiPasquale (left) and Kenney recently joined Washington Trust’s commercial real estate banking group.*


“I’m incredibly excited about the team we’re building and the opportunities ahead,” **said**[Bethany Lyons](https://www.washtrust.com/team/bethany-lyons) **, senior vice president and managing director of commercial real estate, Washington Trust** . “We have a talented group of people who share a strong commitment to our client relationships and continued growth. Angela and Brian bring not only strong industry expertise and well-established industry connections, but also the same core principles of teamwork and a focus on building lasting partnerships that have been central to Washington Trust’s success. Their addition positions us to continue to grow our presence and build meaningful relationships throughout New England.”


“At Washington Trust, our focus is offering trusted advice, access to comprehensive solutions and personalized service that meets clients’ individual and business needs,” **said**[James C. Brown](https://www.washtrust.com/team/james-c-brown) **, senior executive vice president and chief commercial banking officer, Washington Trust** . “I’m thrilled that Angela and Brian have joined Bethany and the rest of our talented commercial real estate team. Having them adds expertise and geographic reach as the Bank delivers relationship-based banking to real estate investors and developers across the Northeast.”


DiPasquale has 14 years of commercial banking experience, with expertise across commercial real estate relationship management, business development, credit analysis and complex loan structuring. Prior to joining Washington Trust, she held commercial real estate relationship management and commercial credit roles at financial institutions based in Connecticut and Massachusetts. DiPasquale earned a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration from the University of Connecticut. She is a 2021 graduate of Leadership Rhode Island, a 2025 graduate of the CREW Boston Leadership Academy, and an active member of CREW Connecticut.


Kenney has worked in the banking industry for eight years, and prior to joining Washington Trust he held commercial real estate relationship management and portfolio management roles with financial institutions in Massachusetts and Delaware. He serves on the board of the Real Estate Lenders Association’s Boston Chapter and is a member of the Real Estate and Finance Association’s Boston Chapter. Kenney earned a Bachelor of Science from the University of Delaware’s Alfred Lerner College of Business & Economics.


**ABOUT THE WASHINGTON TRUST COMPANY**


Founded in 1800, Washington Trust is recognized as the oldest community bank in the nation, the largest state-chartered bank headquartered in Rhode Island and one of the Northeast's premier financial services companies. In 2025, Washington Trust reached a milestone of 225 years in operation, marking its commitment to helping the people, businesses, and organizations of New England improve their financial lives. The Bank offers a wide range of commercial banking, mortgage banking, personal banking and wealth management services through its offices in Rhode Island, Connecticut and Massachusetts and a full suite of convenient digital tools. Washington Trust is a member of the FDIC and an equal housing lender. Washington Trust is a subsidiary of Washington Trust Bancorp, Inc., a publicly-owned holding company which trades on NASDAQ: WASH. For more information, visit the Bank's website at www.washtrust.com or the Corporation's website at ir.washtrust.com.
